acceptance_criteria.AC-FI-1: Every finding emitted by `finding_intake.draft_finding` / batch transcription round-trips the REAL `ConvergenceLedger.ingest_audit` (a scratch ledger in the test) with no `ConvergenceLedgerError`; the derived open set contains exactly the emitted `(file, subject)` keys, and the `DraftFinding` envelope carries all twelve validator fields including `source_finding_ids`. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_finding_intake.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-FI-2: A statement whose root-cause search yields multiple disjoint candidate `required_paths` sets, or no candidate, returns an `IntakeQuestion` naming the candidates; no finding is emitted and nothing is sealed. Guessed attribution is unrepresentable: `draft_finding`'s return type is `DraftFinding | IntakeQuestion` and tests assert the ambiguous cases produce the question. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_finding_intake.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-FI-3: `scripts/report_finding.py` seals accepted findings as one audit envelope (`{digest, findings, verdicts: [], confirmed_good: [], capture_coverage: {}}`) by writing it to a temp file and calling `CampaignArtifactStore.seal`; it never calls `ingest_audit`: after a single-statement report the ledger contains no `audit_ingested` record and no key's `unsuccessful_repair_claims` has incremented. Re-running with byte-identical input reseals the same digest and changes nothing. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_finding_intake.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-FI-4: Batch mode transcribes a seed-audit file of N statements into one sealed artifact; every finding carries `confidence == "S"` unless capture-evidence refs are attached (then `"C+S"`), and judgment-call statements carry `requires_disposition: true`. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_finding_intake.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-FI-5: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_import_boundaries.py -q` passes: `finding_intake` sits in the plangraph layer and no `harness_labs/core` module gains a plangraph import. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_import_boundaries.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-SN-1: A campaign whose config carries the legacy string `pre_journal_sanitizer` behaves identically before and after this change: same validation, same semantics, and a byte-identical `campaign_opened.config` mapping (existing journals re-fold with no drift). OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_convergence_campaign.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-SN-2: The capture CLI accepts `--sanitizer-policy <json-file>` holding the mapping form, mutually exclusive with the legacy `--sanitizer` string: text-kind artifacts pass through the scanning hook, binary kinds follow their declared policy (`scan`, `admit:<reason>`, `reject`), and journaling an artifact whose kind has no declared policy raises `SanitizerError` — fail closed. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_ui_fidelity_capture.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-SN-3: `ui_fidelity_capture --dry-run` over a sample bundle emits a per-artifact report of would-be rejections (naming the refusing rule) and writes nothing to the journal: the journal file is absent or byte-identical after the run. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_ui_fidelity_capture.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-SN-4: `sanitize_before_journaling` in `scripts/run_convergence_campaign.py` resolves the `text` hook out of the mapping config form and applies it to journaled text exactly as the legacy string form does; a mapping config with no `text` entry raises `SanitizerFailure`, never `AttributeError`. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_convergence_campaign_driver.py"}
acceptance_criteria.AC-MC-1: `measurer_commissioning` runs the capture matrix N times through its injected runner callable, emits a per-cell stability report classifying each cell stable/unstable against the declared divergence threshold, and records the threshold in the report; the classification is exercised over stub-driver captures in CI and never skips. acceptance_criteria.AC-MC-2: Commissioning with any chronically unstable cell cannot report success: the run surfaces those cells as explicit ruling requests and exits nonzero until each is ruled (excluded or threshold-amended with a recorded reason). acceptance_criteria.AC-MC-3: Inspector recall calibration scores the inspector against a seed-findings list of ledger finding envelopes supplied as a JSON path argument (the shape `finding_intake --batch` emits, passed as data) and emits a recall report artifact; `harness_labs/core/measurer_commissioning.py` imports nothing from `harness_labs.plangraph`. acceptance_criteria.AC-MC-4: `build_campaign_config` refuses a config lacking `stability_report_digest` and `recall_report_digest` unless it carries `commissioning_override: {"reason": <non-empty>}`, naming each missing artifact in the refusal, so `pin_target` cannot record a `campaign_opened` config without them; every existing `pin_target`/`open_campaign` call site in the granted test files is migrated and green. acceptance_criteria.AC-MC-5: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_import_boundaries.py -q` passes: `harness_labs/core/measurer_commissioning.py` imports nothing from `harness_labs.plangraph`. OBSERVABLE:{"kind": "test_id", "referent": "tests/test_import_boundaries.py"}

acceptance_criteria.AC-LK-4: `experiments/run_convergence_plan_graph.py` is a thin shim: a source scan asserts `run_plan_graph_feature_worktree` no longer appears in it, and the kit's launch config equals the golden dict of AC-LK-1 (parity scoped to the config surface; the documented widenings are outside it). plan_sections.dtr-lk: ### LK — launcher kit and plan synthesis [dtr-lk]

runs.objective: Build the finding-intake lane (DTR-F1): harness_labs/plangraph/finding_intake.py turning free-text statements into contract-valid findings — root-caused required_paths from a working-tree search, derived (file, subject) key, all twelve validator envelope fields including source_finding_ids, confidence S unless capture evidence attached, requires_disposition for judgment calls, ambiguity returned as an IntakeQuestion rather than guessed — plus scripts/report_finding.py with single-statement and --batch seed-audit modes taking explicit --ledger/--campaign-root arguments. Sealing writes the audit envelope to a temp file and seals it via CampaignArtifactStore.seal (import, not modify, convergence_campaign.py; seal_audit_result is NOT the API — it seals only evidence_refs files). The CLI never calls ingest_audit: folding a partial statement mid-round would mark other open keys unobserved and fabricate failed repair claims. Tests validate against the real ledger validator on a scratch ledger, never a mirror of its rules.

Build the sanitizer media-type policy lane (DTR-F2, DTR-F3) across BOTH sanitizer surfaces, named precisely: capture-side resolve_sanitizer/sanitize_before_journal in scripts/ui_fidelity_capture.py (dispatches on artifact kind, raises SanitizerError) and driver-side resolve_pre_journal_sanitizer/sanitize_before_journaling in scripts/run_convergence_campaign.py (reads CONFIG_SANITIZER_KEY, raises SanitizerFailure). Campaign config accepts the legacy string (byte-identical campaign_opened.config mapping) or the mapping form {text: hook, binary: {kind: scan|admit:<reason>|reject}}; the driver resolves the text hook from the mapping exactly as the legacy path and raises SanitizerFailure (never AttributeError) on a mapping without a text entry; the policy reaches the capture CLI as --sanitizer-policy <json-file>, mutually exclusive with legacy --sanitizer; undeclared binary kinds fail closed; --dry-run reports would-be rejections and journals nothing. Mechanism only: PHI or other policy content stays product config, not harness code.

Extract the proven experiments launcher into harness_labs/graphrun/campaign_launcher.py (DTR-F5) behind a product-config surface: build_campaign_launch_config() returns a plain mapping pinned against a literal golden dict transcribing experiments/run_convergence_plan_graph.py at base 8a13917 (coordinator spec + 7200.0s silence tolerance, implementer/reviewer specs and models, recovery_limit=5, continuation_recovery_limit=3, verification_repair_limit=3, allow_dirty_baseline, require_repository_change, candidate_only, merge=False, max_parallelism=5, plan/decomposition paths, logical graph id, agent-mixture specs, profile-builder hook, and a parameterized operator-notes directory in place of the hardcoded logs/plan-approval/operator-notes path). Operator-notes fold into implementer/review/fix instructions. Two documented widenings outside the parity scope: a single shared ANTI_PLACEHOLDER_FLOOR constant included in all four worker instructions (source carries two divergent copies in implementer and fix only), and CC-08 wiring per ADR 0007 (escalation_judge seat, transfer_ownership in automatic_recovery.allowed_actions, max_structural_decisions bound — the source launcher predates CC-08). The experiments script becomes a thin shim: run_plan_graph_feature_worktree no longer appears in it.

Build the measurer-commissioning lane (DTR-F4): harness_labs/core/measurer_commissioning.py (plain JSON in / plain JSON out, imports nothing from harness_labs.plangraph) runs the capture matrix N times through an injected runner callable, emits a per-cell stability report against a declared divergence threshold (threshold recorded in the report, exercised over stub-driver captures in CI), refuses silent success while any cell is chronically unstable (explicit ruling requests, nonzero exit until ruled), and calibrates inspector recall against a seed-findings JSON file (the finding_intake --batch envelope shape, passed as data). scripts/commission_measurer.py drives both and seals both reports via CampaignArtifactStore. The campaign-open checklist lands at the real seat: build_campaign_config gains stability_report_digest and recall_report_digest keys and refuses a config lacking them absent commissioning_override:{reason}, so pin_target cannot record campaign_opened without them; every existing call site in the granted test files (test_convergence_campaign.py, test_convergence_campaign_driver.py, test_convergence_lifecycle.py) is migrated in this run. The driver's close step derives inspector_recall from the sealed recall report when not supplied. An ADR (docs/decisions/0008-campaign-open-commissioning-checklist.md) records the new refusal authority. Depends on DTR-FI (seed envelope shape as data) and DTR-SN (single-writer serialization of convergence_campaign.py and the driver).

Build plan synthesis and its driver wiring (DTR-F6), sink node. harness_labs/plangraph/plan_synthesis.py turns the ledger's open findings into a decomposition JSON: allowed_paths per run equal the union of its findings' required_paths (ownership derives from required_paths alone), every grant carries a path intent, every criterion text carries a trailing OBSERVABLE:{kind, referent} annotation (no S5_MISSING_OBSERVABLE finding), the payload round-trips canonical_plan_graph_payload unchanged (the top-level key set is closed — no invented fields), and the result satisfies the driver's round contract: join_regression_node_id resolves and validate_round_grants passes. ConvergenceLedger gains open_findings() returning the folded finding envelope per open key, so synthesis never re-folds the journal. Driver wiring: the plan step invokes synthesis; the approve path threads enforce=True through BOTH render_approval_packet and issue_approval (same value both sides — the issue-side TOCTOU re-derivation refuses on drift); scripts/approve_plan.py is unchanged (the enforce path is driver-only). Updates docs/development/INDEX.md. Runs the lane gate plus the full-suite gate.
